name: Checksum AI
description: Generates, runs, and heals end-to-end tests for AI-written code, plugging into coding agents through slash commands and into CI through GitHub checks.

skills.name: Test Generation
skills.description: Generates end-to-end test suites from application behaviour and recent code changes without hand-written scripts.

skills.name: Test Healing
skills.description: Repairs tests that break from UI or flow changes, keeping suites green as agent-written code keeps shifting.

skills.name: Agent Integration
skills.description: Exposes test runs to coding agents through slash commands so quality checks happen inside the editing loop.
